text: Philosophy is a fundamental discipline that studies the essence of the world, human thinking, values and social laws. It aims to explore fundamental issues such as "existence", "knowledge", "morality" and "truth" through logical speculation, conceptual analysis and an interdisciplinary perspective. It is not only the theoretical cornerstone of the humanities and social sciences, but also deeply intertwined with fields such as natural science, art, and religion, cultivating students' critical thinking, logical reasoning, and abstract generalization abilities.
